subject.title: feat(ios): Talk camera flip control and mic input selection

question: Should a user’s iOS Talk camera preference redefine the public default for camera node commands that omit `facing`, or should omitted node commands retain the documented front-camera contract?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes a public command default through persisted device-local state; source fixes alone cannot determine whether that compatibility tradeoff is the intended product contract.

options.title: Keep the documented front default
options.body: Preserve omitted-facing behavior for programmatic node commands and scope any user camera selection to an explicitly designed Talk capture contract.

options.title: Adopt the persisted iOS preference
options.body: Make omission intentionally resolve through the iOS user preference, update the nodes documentation and callers, and prove the upgrade behavior.

options.title: Add an explicit capture mode
options.body: Keep omission stable while adding a distinct, documented opt-in parameter or action for user-preferred camera capture.

recommendation.title: Adopt the persisted iOS preference
recommendation.body: Make omission intentionally resolve through the iOS user preference, update the nodes documentation and callers, and prove the upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch spans the affected iOS and shared Talk surfaces, though direct current-main feature-history ownership remains unverified.
